name: Wikipedia tallest-building comparison
goal: Find the tallest building in Seattle on Wikipedia, note its height in meters, then find the tallest building in Portland, Oregon, and stop when you can compare the two heights.
notes: Expected outcome: copy the metric heights for the tallest buildings in both cities and stop when they can be compared. Representative run: about 11 steps, 43 Jev calls, 340,000 tokens, $0.014, and 17 seconds.
